l.i: Huc igitur multo turgentia lumina fletu
Aduertens mæstus sublimi Dauid ab arce,
Vesperere iam feras noctis properante tenebras,
At tu, tu nostri domus (inquit) conscia luctus,
Tu mihi testis eris iustorum nempe dolorum.
Sic fauteas nostro rubicunda ex crimine luna:
(Forte erat aut Sisa est Phoebe rubicudior) at
Sydera, quæ inuisos toties vidistis amores,
Mutatum spectate virum. Sic fatus, eburnam
Suspendit zona citharam, quasi fuetus ad omnes
Mentis erat curas Sti, quæ sape sonante
Depulerat sanos inimico à rege furores.

main_text.l: Imbre oculos cælo attollit: tandémque recepta
Mente, miser tales tremebundo pectore fletus
Barbarus immanes, Sultrice in numinis ira,
Effudit populos, sceleratæ mœnia Romæ, Et quacunque prius spoliato ex orbe sacrarant
Partim æquasse solo, partim iniecisse Soraci
Confumenda rogo: Vt qua olim fastigia cælis

page.notes: The text is partly worn; the verse lines are reconstructed where letters were doubtful (e.g. "Sisa", "Soraci", "Sultrice"), and such readings may be inexact. The signature "A 3" is at the foot right.
